Technical Design & Architecture Specification

Profile & Message Screen UI Redesign

A comprehensive mobile redesign for Linkhain featuring Seller Sold Portfolios with Made-to-Order Custom Commissions, Buyer Saved Favorites, and Bi-Directional Campus Chat with Pinned Escrow Terms.
Target Project Linkhain Campus Hub
Screens Redesigned UserProfile & Inbox
Delivery Format Interactive HTML + PDF
AIA Source Integrity Preserved (No AIA overwrite)

1. Executive Summary & Design Rationale

This document details the refined user interface architecture for Linkhain’s two most critical transaction touchpoints: the User Profile Screen (UserProfile) and the Message / Negotiation Screen (Inbox). In university peer-to-peer marketplaces, two recurring challenges degrade trust and repeat commerce:

  • Seller Inactivity After Stock Depletion: Student creators and artisans (e.g., crochet artists, digital template creators, 3D/resin makers) sell single unique items that quickly disappear from active feeds, leaving their profiles empty and preventing interested buyers from ordering replicas.
  • Unstructured Chat Negotiations: Campus meetup coordination via generic chat feeds often results in missed rendezvous, unclear price confirmations, and confusion over who spoke last.
Core Innovation: The redesigned Profile Screen introduces a dedicated Seller Portfolio of Past Sold Items with an active [ ✦ Commission Similar Item ] CTA button, paired with a Buyer Wishlist of Saved Favorites. The redesigned Message Screen introduces Bi-Directional Speech Bubbles (Seller on the left in light card style; Buyer on the right in signature Maroon) anchored by a Sticky Pinned Deal Card and Instant Campus Quick-Reply Chips.

4. Profile Screen Walkthrough (UserProfile)

The redesigned Profile screen incorporates an interactive segmented role switcher allowing students to seamlessly toggle between Seller Portfolio and Buyer Favorites.

A. Seller Mode: Sold Portfolio
Displays past sold creations with "SOLD OUT" badges and the "✦ Commission Similar Item" CTA.
B. Buyer Mode: Saved Favorites
Displays hearted marketplace items with active red hearts, prices, and direct meetup order buttons.
Profile Component Interactive Behavior Technical Value
Institutional Hero Card Displays avatar, name, verified checkmark, department (BSIS 3B), and campus location. Builds immediate peer trust and eliminates campus identity fraud.
4-Metric Trust Bar Aggregates ratings (4.98 ★), total items sold (24), meetup rate (100%), and response time (<5m). Presents student seller reliability at a glance.
Sold Portfolio Grid Lists completed student works with historical sold price (₱480) and verified student reviews. Turns past sales into marketing assets for custom re-orders.
Saved Favorites Grid 2-column grid of saved cards with live stock tags and active heart indicators. Provides a direct personal wishlist for campus buyers.

6. Message Screen Key Innovations (Inbox)

  • Bi-Directional Side Alignment: Incoming messages from the student seller appear on the Left with their verified avatar and white card backing; outgoing buyer messages appear on the Right in signature Maroon with teal delivery ticks (✓✓ Read).
  • Sticky Pinned Transaction Card: The item being negotiated (e.g. Handmade Matcha Frog Plushie · ₱480.00 · PSU Library Gate 3) stays permanently anchored at the top of the chat, eliminating price ambiguity during meetup handoffs.
  • One-Tap Campus Quick Replies: Horizontal scroll chips allow students to tap preset campus status updates ("At Library Gate 3", "Exact ₱480 Cash Ready", "Running 5m Late") with automated realistic seller replies.

7. Cloud Database Architecture & Data Schema

The redesigned Profile and Message workflows interface with the Linkhain Redis-backed MIT CloudDB service using structured key-value serialization:

Data Domain CloudDB Key Format Schema & Payload Description
User Accounts user:<email> Stores student name, campus ID, department, verification status, and credentials.
Seller Sold Items sold:<seller_email> JSON list of completed items: title, original sold price (₱), photos, and buyer reviews.
Buyer Favorites favs:<buyer_email> JSON list of saved listing IDs bookmarked by the student buyer.
Commission Contracts comm:<comm_id> 5-stage milestone tracking: Brief Submitted → Artist Accepts → In-Progress Preview → Buyer Approved → Completed.
Chat Threads thread:<thread_id> Ordered list of messages: [sender_email, message_text, timestamp, media_url, is_read].
